aggregation: Within each group, equal weight decision events per ET decision day, then equal weight observed days; repeated symbol/day signals retained and separately counted. Not portfolio PnL/PF/DD.
cost_formula: exit_close*(1-c)/(entry_open*(1+c))-1; same cost for SPY; assumptions not measured fees
known_results: Prior fixed-band realized PnL and score saturation known; not independent/OOS and no challenger.
limits: no candidate selection or S3/S4 batch
no production source/config/data writes or network
outcome: next-session OPEN to CLOSE of fifth expected session after decision date (entry session inclusive). All five OHLCV bars and SPY bars required; do not compress missing sessions.
population: All frozen archived decisions; count all exclusions. Numeric finite score 0..1 and action BUY only. Unique decision_id; duplicate conflicts rejected as a group.
price_basis: Frozen r11 cache from prior study. Adjustment/revision/availability unqualified. Price-only, no dividend/FX. Diagnostic proxy only.
time: decision_time if explicit otherwise generated_at; timezone-aware only. Next ET calendar session strictly after decision ET date. This is an observed timestamp proxy, not proof of creation or availability.
uncertainty: 5bps same-day SPY excess; 20 expected-session moving blocks including days without eligible rows; 4000 draws seed7; sparse/overlapping sample sensitivity only, not edge probability.
